hero.subtitle: Drainage design for compliant stormwater and wastewater networks

paragraphs: InfoDrainage supports sustainable drainage design with analysis for attenuation, treatment, and connection to wider networks.
Aptus Infotech provides InfoDrainage as part of Autodesk's water infrastructure portfolio.

items.title: Stormwater Design
items.body: Size pipes, channels, and storage for rainfall events.

items.title: SuDS & Treatment
items.body: Model sustainable drainage and treatment components.

items.title: Standards Compliance
items.body: Apply regional design standards and reporting requirements.

items.title: CAD Integration
items.body: Exchange results with Civil 3D and InfoWorks platforms.

items.title: Authorized Autodesk Partner
items.body: Genuine licenses, official support channels, and access to current Autodesk product versions.

items.title: Implementation Support
items.body: Guidance on deployment, collections, and integration with your existing IT and project workflows.

items.title: Local Expertise
items.body: Muscat-based team providing responsive sales, technical support, and training across Oman.

items.title: End-to-End Service
items.body: From license procurement and renewal to rollout planning — a single trusted partner for Autodesk.
